notes.text: Jonathan Marchessault is day to day (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward.

Nicolas Hague has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Daemon Hunt has taken his spot beside Jayden Struble. That pair has had 44% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 47:17 together, up from 29% with Hague.
Shane Wright joined from SEA on Nov 2 and has played beside Filip Forsberg and Nils Höglander.
Adam Edström has started killing penalties: on the ice for 33% of the team’s shorthanded time in 17 games, up from 1% with his old team last season.
Troy Terry is on long-term injured reserve (hip surgery) and has missed the last 9 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
A.J. Greer is on injured reserve (upper body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Nico Myatovic has taken his spot beside Sam Colangelo and Tim Washe.
Tyson Hinds has not dressed for the last 5 games. Travis Mitchell has taken his spot beside Tristan Luneau. That pair has had 28% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 31:51 together, down from 62% with Hinds.
Laurent Brossoit was added to the roster on Nov 3.

story.head: The Ducks are on a heater
paras: The Ducks are on a tear, five straight wins. The Predators have won four straight. The Predators played last night, and the Ducks are rested. Going in, the Predators are fourth in the Central (tied for 12th in the NHL) and the Ducks third in the Pacific (tied for 12th).

The Predators’ record (.618) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.535), largely thanks to pulling off wins in one-goal games. So is the Ducks’ (.583 on chances worth .488), largely thanks to their finishing.
In their five-game winning streak, the Ducks have outscored teams 26-16, but only 9-7 at 5-on-5. On special teams, they’ve outscored teams 14-6 in that time.

The Predators keep things calm after the whistle (2nd lowest), get pinned in their own end on long shifts (31st) and give up a lot of shots (31st). On the other side, the Ducks are one of the league’s most physical teams (2nd) and give up a lot of dangerous shots (31st). They also forecheck as hard as almost anyone (3rd), so the Ducks hound the puck, but the Preds sit back. Anaheim has scored 3.83 goals a game, the fourth most in the league, and allowed 3.67, the third most. Both teams like to play fast, so expect an open game.

Filip Forsberg (5 G / 15 A / 20 P in 17 GP) leads the Predators in scoring, with seven points in his last five games and six goals in nine games against Anaheim since 2023-24. Steven Stamkos (10 G / 9 A / 19 P in 17 GP) has a team-high ten goals. Leo Carlsson (6 G / 20 A / 26 P in 18 GP) leads the Ducks in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with eight points in his last five games. Cutter Gauthier (15 G / 7 A / 22 P in 17 GP) has a team-high 15 goals, third in the NHL, with 13 points in his last five games.

Justus Annunen (3-1-0 / .873 SV% in 4 GS) will likely start for Nashville. Anaheim has two options in net: Laurent Brossoit (4-0-0 / .876 SV% in 4 GS) and Lukáš Dostál (4-4-1 / .866 SV% in 10 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Brossoit got the last one on Sunday. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.
